scope: v1.8 single-domain seed — AI/CS only. Other domains deferred.

difficulty_legend.1: first exposure, can be done in one sitting with no prior context
difficulty_legend.4: frontier-adjacent; deep prereq chain; requires hands-on synthesis
difficulty_legend.5: research-level; requires reading recent papers and reproducing

nodes.name: Python Basics
nodes.canonical_example: Implement FizzBuzz, then a class-based counter with state
frontier_bridges: Modern Python typing + dataclasses unlock structured-output pydantic schemas in Agent layer

nodes.name: Data Structures (list/dict/set/tuple/heap)
nodes.canonical_example: Implement LRU cache with OrderedDict; top-k with heapq
frontier_bridges: Dict-as-vocab underpins tokenizer BPE merges

nodes.name: Algorithmic Complexity (Big-O)
nodes.canonical_example: Compare O(n^2) bubble-sort vs O(n log n) merge-sort empirically
frontier_bridges: O(n^2) attention is the wall Mamba/SSM/FlashAttention attack

nodes.name: Vectors & Dot Product
nodes.canonical_example: Cosine similarity between two TF-IDF vectors over Wikipedia stubs
frontier_bridges: Dot product IS attention's scoring kernel

nodes.name: Matrix Multiplication & Rank
nodes.canonical_example: Compute a 3x3 by 3x2 by hand, then in NumPy, verify shape rules
frontier_bridges: Low-rank decomposition is the LoRA fine-tuning kernel

nodes.name: Eigenvalues & SVD
nodes.canonical_example: SVD-compress an image to rank-20; observe reconstruction error
frontier_bridges: SVD undergirds PCA, latent semantic indexing, and LoRA's truncated-rank insight
frontier_recommended_reading: Strang ch. 6; Trefethen & Bau Numerical Linear Algebra

nodes.name: Derivatives & Gradients
nodes.canonical_example: Gradient of f(x,y)=x^2+3xy by hand; verify with autograd
frontier_bridges: Backprop = chain rule applied at scale

nodes.name: Chain Rule for Composite Functions
nodes.canonical_example: Derive d/dx of sigmoid(W*x+b) layer by layer
frontier_bridges: Mechanical core of every backward pass in PyTorch

nodes.name: Probability Basics (Bayes, Conditional)
nodes.canonical_example: Bayes posterior for a coin after 7 heads in 10 flips
frontier_bridges: Bayesian view of LLM training: posterior over weights given corpus

nodes.name: Distributions (Gaussian, Categorical, Softmax)
nodes.canonical_example: Sample 1000 points from N(0,1); fit a histogram; verify central limit
frontier_bridges: Softmax over vocab is the literal output head of every LLM

nodes.name: Maximum Likelihood Estimation
nodes.canonical_example: MLE for Gaussian mean and variance from i.i.d. samples
frontier_bridges: Cross-entropy loss IS negative log-likelihood under categorical model

nodes.name: Linear Regression
nodes.canonical_example: Fit Boston housing prices closed-form vs gradient descent; compare
frontier_bridges: The simplest model where the optimization-vs-closed-form tradeoff appears

nodes.name: Logistic Regression
nodes.canonical_example: Predict spam vs ham on a 1000-email corpus; report AUC
frontier_bridges: Single-neuron classifier — the atom that scales to deep nets

nodes.name: k-Nearest Neighbors
nodes.canonical_example: kNN on MNIST with k=3; observe error rate vs k
frontier_bridges: kNN over embeddings IS modern retrieval (FAISS, vector DB)

nodes.name: Decision Trees
nodes.canonical_example: Build a CART tree on Iris; visualize splits; measure information gain
frontier_bridges: Foundation for boosted ensembles still dominant on tabular data (XGBoost)

nodes.name: Random Forest & Bagging
nodes.canonical_example: Ensemble 100 trees on a Kaggle tabular set; compare to single tree
frontier_bridges: Bagging principle persists in dropout, model souping

nodes.name: Support Vector Machines
nodes.canonical_example: Train RBF-kernel SVM on two-moons; visualize margin
frontier_bridges: Kernel trick foreshadows attention as a learned kernel

nodes.name: k-Means Clustering
nodes.canonical_example: Cluster a 2D Gaussian mixture, plot Voronoi cells
frontier_bridges: Clustering over embeddings is the basis of topic discovery in modern corpora

nodes.name: Overfitting & Cross-Validation
nodes.canonical_example: Polynomial fit degree 1 through 15 on 20 points; pick by 5-fold CV
frontier_bridges: LLM eval contamination is a 2024-2026 instance of this 50-year-old problem

nodes.name: Perceptron & MLP
nodes.canonical_example: Implement a 2-layer MLP from scratch in NumPy; learn XOR
frontier_bridges: Universal approximation theorem licenses the entire field

nodes.name: Backpropagation
nodes.canonical_example: Hand-derive grads for a 2-layer net; verify numerically
frontier_bridges: Single algorithm runs every modern DL system; FlashAttention only optimizes its compute pattern

nodes.name: Optimization (SGD, Adam, LR Schedules)
nodes.canonical_example: Compare SGD vs Adam vs AdamW on CIFAR-10; plot loss curves
frontier_bridges: Muon, Shampoo, second-order optimizers are 2025 frontier returning to favor
frontier_recommended_reading: Kingma & Ba Adam paper; Loshchilov AdamW

nodes.name: Regularization (Dropout, Weight Decay, BatchNorm)
nodes.canonical_example: Ablate dropout 0.0/0.3/0.5 on a small CNN; measure val gap
frontier_bridges: LayerNorm + RMSNorm dominate LLMs; BatchNorm sidelined for sequence models

nodes.name: Convolutional Neural Networks
nodes.canonical_example: Train LeNet on MNIST; visualize first-layer filters
frontier_bridges: ConvNeXt (2022) and vision transformers re-merge: locality-vs-attention still alive

nodes.name: Recurrent Networks (RNN, LSTM, GRU)
nodes.canonical_example: Char-RNN that generates Shakespeare-like text
frontier_bridges: Mamba/SSM/RWKV revive recurrence with linear-time properties

nodes.name: Attention Mechanism
nodes.canonical_example: Implement scaled-dot-product attention by hand for 4 tokens
frontier_bridges: FlashAttention v3 / sliding-window / linear attention remain hot 2025 research

nodes.name: Transformer Architecture
nodes.canonical_example: Implement a 1-layer encoder-decoder on a copy task; visualize attention heads
frontier_bridges: Every GPT / Claude / Gemini descends from Vaswani 2017; understand it or you're guessing
frontier_recommended_reading: Vaswani Attention Is All You Need; Karpathy nanoGPT

nodes.name: Tokenization (BPE, WordPiece, SentencePiece)
nodes.canonical_example: Build a BPE tokenizer from scratch on a 1MB corpus
frontier_bridges: Tokenization choices cause Chinese/code/math failure modes seen in production

nodes.name: Word & Sentence Embeddings
nodes.canonical_example: Train word2vec on a small corpus; show king-man+woman~queen
frontier_bridges: E5 / BGE-M3 / OpenAI text-embed-3 are the descendants powering RAG today

nodes.name: Causal LM Pretraining Objective
nodes.canonical_example: Pretrain a 10M-param GPT on TinyStories; loss curve to <2.0
frontier_bridges: Scaling laws (Hoffmann Chinchilla 2022) still set 2025 compute budgets
frontier_recommended_reading: Radford GPT-2; Hoffmann Chinchilla; Karpathy nanoGPT

nodes.name: Fine-tuning & LoRA
nodes.canonical_example: LoRA-tune a 1B model on instruction data with r=8; measure perplexity drop
frontier_bridges: DoRA, ReFT, QLoRA continue the 'cheap adapter' line

nodes.name: RLHF and Alignment (PPO, DPO)
nodes.canonical_example: Implement DPO on a preference dataset; compare to SFT
frontier_bridges: DPO replaced PPO for most alignment teams 2024; RLAIF, KTO, IPO are 2024-25 evolutions
frontier_recommended_reading: Ouyang InstructGPT 2022; Rafailov DPO 2023; Christiano RLHF 2017

nodes.name: Prompt Engineering & Few-Shot
nodes.canonical_example: Same task, 5 prompt variants; measure accuracy variance on 50 examples
frontier_bridges: Prompt brittleness remains the #1 prod failure mode; mitigations: schema, n-shot tuning

nodes.name: Chain-of-Thought & Reasoning
nodes.canonical_example: GSM8K with plain prompt vs CoT vs self-consistency; tabulate
frontier_bridges: o1/o3/R1 'reasoning models' are CoT internalized via RL; opaque-CoT debate is live 2025
frontier_recommended_reading: Wei CoT 2022; Wang Self-Consistency 2022; OpenAI o1 blog 2024

nodes.name: LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.canonical_example: Eval a 7B model on MMLU subset; analyze 3 failure clusters by hand
frontier_bridges: Eval contamination + Goodhart make 2025 benchmarks suspect; ARC-AGI, HLE attempt fresh leakage-resistant probes
frontier_recommended_reading: Hendrycks MMLU 2021; Liang HELM 2023; Chollet ARC-AGI 2024

nodes.name: ReAct Pattern (Reason + Act)
nodes.canonical_example: Build a 2-tool ReAct loop (search + calculator) that answers a multi-hop question
frontier_bridges: Anthropic Managed Agents 2025 still ReAct underneath, formalized as event-log
frontier_recommended_reading: Yao ReAct 2022; Anthropic Building Effective Agents 2024

nodes.name: Tool Use & Function Calling
nodes.canonical_example: Wire 5 tools, observe schema-validation failures, build retry layer
frontier_bridges: MCP (Anthropic Model Context Protocol, 2024) standardizes tool surface

nodes.name: Agent Memory (Short, Episodic, Long-term)
nodes.canonical_example: Build a 3-tier memory (chat buffer + episodic SQLite + semantic vector) on a 100-turn dialog
frontier_bridges: MemGPT, Letta, Generative Agents (Park 2023) all converge on tiered memory

nodes.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
nodes.canonical_example: Build RAG over a 100-doc Wikipedia subset; measure recall@5
frontier_bridges: GraphRAG (Microsoft 2024), LightRAG, ColBERT-v2 lead the 2025 RAG frontier

nodes.name: Multi-Agent Systems
nodes.canonical_example: 3-role debate agent (proposer / critic / judge) on a coding task
frontier_bridges: AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Swarm are 2024 entries; coordination overhead remains unsolved

nodes.name: Agent Evaluation & Trajectory Analysis
nodes.canonical_example: Define a 5-step success rubric for a web-research agent; score 20 trajectories
frontier_bridges: WebArena, GAIA, SWE-bench are 2024 frontier benchmarks for end-to-end agent eval

nodes.name: Function Calling & Structured Output
nodes.canonical_example: Force-extract {name, email, intent} JSON from 50 messy user emails; report parse rate
frontier_bridges: JSON-mode, tools/function calling, structured-outputs grammars all converge 2024-25

nodes.name: Streaming, Cancellation, Backpressure
nodes.canonical_example: Stream a long generation; implement abort on user interrupt; handle reconnect
frontier_bridges: SSE vs WebSocket vs gRPC streaming choice is a 2025 prod design tradeoff
frontier_recommended_reading: OpenAI streaming docs; Anthropic Messages API streaming

nodes.name: Cost & Latency Optimization
nodes.canonical_example: Route 1000 requests across cheap/strong tiers; halve cost while keeping quality > 95%
frontier_bridges: Cheap-router patterns (T0/T1/T2/T3 cascade) dominate 2025 production agent stacks

nodes.name: Prompt & KV-Cache Caching
nodes.canonical_example: Use Anthropic prompt caching for a 100K-token system prompt; measure hit rate over 50 calls
frontier_bridges: KV-cache as service, prefix caching, paged attention all 2024-25 inference frontier

nodes.name: Eval Pipelines & Regression Guards
nodes.canonical_example: Build a CI eval harness that blocks deploys on > 2% regression across 200 cases
frontier_bridges: Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, Inspect-AI form 2025 eval-tooling layer
frontier_recommended_reading: Inspect-AI by UK AISI 2024; Promptfoo docs

nodes.name: Safety, Guardrails & Red-Team
nodes.canonical_example: Add prompt-injection + PII + tool-misuse guards; red-team with 20 adversarial inputs
frontier_bridges: NeMo Guardrails, Lakera, Llama Guard 3 form a 2024-25 safety layer; prompt injection remains unsolved
frontier_recommended_reading: Greshake prompt injection 2023; Anthropic constitutional AI 2022

nodes.name: Observability, Tracing, Logging
nodes.canonical_example: Instrument an agent with OpenTelemetry spans; trace one failure end-to-end
frontier_bridges: Honeycomb, Phoenix, LangSmith trace-first observability emerging as 2025 norm
